Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations support elevated prices.

Silver.note: Strong industrial solar demand combined with precious metal tailwinds.

Copper.note: Tight concentrate markets and structural grid demand offset macro softness.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and restarting nuclear capacity drive long-term contracting.

Lithium.note: Near-term EV demand growth slowing while new supply comes online.

Nickel.note: Indonesian supply surplus continues to weigh on prices despite EV demand.

Zinc.note: Recent mine closures and smelter treatment charge squeezes tighten the market.

Iron Ore.note: Chinese property sector weakness offsets steady infrastructure and export demand.

Coal.note: Long-term thermal demand destruction and high global inventories cap upside.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks and EV motor demand provide a floor despite weak spot.

Manganese.note: Steady but unspectacular steel production demand limits pricing power.

PGM.note: Substitution by battery EVs and weak auto production weigh on long-term demand.

Potash.note: Stable global agricultural application rates balance geopolitical supply risks.

Aluminum.note: Chinese capacity caps and rising green energy demand support a structural deficit.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to precious and base metals provides a solid risk-adjusted return.
